description: The signing-steps lesson for an x402 payment: the authorization fields, the EIP-712 / Solana signing operation, and the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE retry — the same steps regardless of your specific challenge. Decode your own challenge first with read-this-challenge. Provisions explains what to run; it never signs for you.

challenge.description: Optional: the decoded challenge you're working from. The steps are the same either way — this lesson does not tailor per-challenge (use read-this-challenge for that).

name: how-do-i-pay
